title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-08-25
content:
Weekly sync notes - Solutions Engineering + Professional Services
Date: 2026-08-25
Owner / scribe: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Marta, Samir, Lena, Tom (Customer Success check-in)
Duration: 45m
---
Agenda:
- Quick round-robin: customer statuses (Acme Health, Finova, EduSpark)
- Highlight blockers and escalation needs
- Next-week milestones and rollout windows
- Action items and owners

Notes:
1) Acme Health (onboarding for V1 clinical chat assistant)
- Current phase: Private deployment staging (VPC + KMS). Staging env deployed 2026-08-22.
- Work completed: model pinning to redwood-gpt-7b-quant, SSO SAML handshake validated in staging, initial smoke tests pass for short prompts.
- Observed issues: large-document search (context > 32k tokens) shows ~2.1s higher tail latency on generation; Samir traced to KV cache eviction pattern when multiple concurrent sessions hit same pod.
- Open tickets: JIRA-SEPS-342 (KV cache eviction mitigation) assigned to Samir, target ETA 2026-09-01.
- Data & compliance: customer requested additional audit logs for inference payloads (redact PII option). Marta to scope effort with security.
- Migration plan: cutover window proposed 2026-09-10 after canary with 5% traffic for 48 hours. Must confirm security sign-off by 2026-09-07.

2) Finova (dedicated capacity, financial data ingestion pipeline)
- Current phase: Dedicated capacity provisioning and model tuning.
- Work completed: Reserved pool provisioned (4x A100 equiv), infra PR merged for firewall rules (GH #412).
- Blockers: Customer's firewall change request requires IP allowlist updates in their PROD VPC; networking team needs customer confirmation on static egress IPs. Ben following up; customer committed to confirm by 2026-08-27.
- Performance notes: initial throughput tests show expected QPS but ~8% higher token cost due to small batch sizes from unpredictable traffic bursts. Recommend enabling adaptive batching with a 25ms delay for non-interactive endpoints. Action: Aisha to propose batching config by 2026-08-28.
- Security: KMS integration pending key policy review (PROJ-678).

3) EduSpark (pilot for proctoring + content generation)
- Current phase: Eval + small pilot in hosted API.
- Work completed: Prompt set v1 evaluated, quality metrics reviewed; recall on factual prompts at 86%.
- Open items: customer requests deterministic responses for grading workflow - need to discuss temperature=0.0 with caching implications. Marta to present options (deterministic sampling + output hashing) on 2026-08-27 call.
- Billing: pilot usage approaching free credit cap; CS recommending upgrade to a metered trial. Tom to own outreach.

Cross-cutting items:
- Observability: Rolling out per-route latency histograms in Console. Early rollout shows percentile spikes correlated with KV cache evictions. SRE will add tracing hooks for a/b trials. (Linked: Confluence trace design doc)
- Rollouts: Canary tooling ready; reminder that dedicated customers need manual approval for auto-fallback to hosted variants. Add to runbook.
- Evals & quality monitoring: set up regression alerts for prompt set 'clinical-summary-001' for Acme; threshold: drop >3 F1 points triggers rollback. Action: Samir to configure alert by 2026-08-30.

Decisions made:
- Use redwood-gpt-7b-quant for Acme initial rollout to balance latency and cost.
- Adaptive batching recommended for Finova with conservative 25ms delay and target batch size 4.

Action items:
- Samir: implement KV cache eviction mitigation (JIRA-SEPS-342) and provide progress update in next sync (ETA 2026-09-01).
- Marta: scope PII-redaction/audit-logs for Acme and produce security impact note (due 2026-09-03).
- Ben: follow up with Finova on static egress IP confirmation (due 2026-08-27).
- Aisha: propose adaptive batching config + rollout plan for Finova (due 2026-08-28).
- Tom (CS): engage EduSpark on metered trial upgrade and confirm by 2026-08-29.
- Samir: configure clinical-summary-001 regression alert in monitoring (due 2026-08-30).

Risks / Blockers:
- KV cache issue could cause tail-latency regressions on high-concurrency customers (priority high).
- Acme security sign-off is gating cutover; if delayed >2026-09-07, push rollout by 1 week.
- Finova IP confirmation delay could block dedicated pool to PROD swap.

Follow-ups / Next sync (2026-09-01) agenda suggestions:
- Deep-dive on KV cache mitigation progress
- Confirm Acme security sign-off and canary runbook
- Finalize batching config for Finova and scheduling for throughput test
- EduSpark deterministic response proposal and decision

Notes to self / informal:
- Need to add SRE contact mapping to runbook (Lena).
- Quick hack: locally repro of cache eviction needs larger concurrency generator (>200 sessions).
- Remember to add Confluence links to final meeting notes before publishing.

Attachments / Links referenced:
- Acme integration spec (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Acme+Health+Integration+Spec
- JIRA tickets: JIRA-SEPS-342, JIRA-PROJ-678
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

End of notes.
